original_summary: Net-negative BTC/ETH week with midweek drawdown and partial recovery; ETHBTC rose. Near-term features favored elevated pullback/consolidation risk, while positive 72h returns, ETHBTC persistence, neutral CFGI and mixed microstructure prevented a confirmed breakdown. The package marked experiment registry evidence unavailable.

eligible_learning_state.key_learning: Before the W37 Master Monday package, the experiment lifecycle contained multiple MATURED_SUPPORTED range candidates, including BTC range families with substantial matured outcome counts and an ETH range family; semantic admission separately suppressed duplicates. Replication remained unverified/incomplete for material families.
eligible_learning_state.integration_defect: The W37 Master Monday scorecard reported experiment registry evidence unavailable despite a fresh registry existing before the weekly package cutoff.

consultation.range_context: Duplicate-adjusted matured shadow evidence materially strengthens the plausibility of consolidation/range as the best research interpretation of the mixed W37 sequence. It does not establish forecast skill and must not become a canonical range forecast automatically.
consultation.contradiction_context: Weak breadth and short-horizon deterioration coexist with ETHBTC persistence, positive 72h evidence and squeeze risk; accumulated range learning supports preserving uncertainty rather than forcing a breakdown/continuation binary.
consultation.method_improvement_candidate: Master Monday preflight should require a provenance-validated experiment-learning pointer and fail explicitly when the pointer is stale/unreadable instead of silently dropping available learning state.
